test_title: PYST 30: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 316 562 149 379 433 (Right)

(Example: 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)

(NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.)

What will be the resultant if the second digit of the highest number is added to the third digit of the lowest number?
solution:
Given series: (Left) 316 562 149 379 433 (Right)

According to the question.

 
 

 Given
 316
 562
 149
 379
 433
 
 

 Arranged in ascending order
 149
 316
 379
 433
 562
 
 

So,

Second digit of the highest number → 5__**6**__2 → 6

Third digit of the lowest number → 14__**9**__ → 9

So, the second digit of the highest number is added to the third digit of the lowest number → 6 + 9 = 15

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
